info.name: Inji Certify With Sunbird Insurance
info.description:
Sunbird RC insurance issuance via eSignet (knowledge-based auth) and Inji Certify.

Select environment `ENV Sunbird Insurance`, then:
1. OIDC Client Mgmt: once per deployment, to register the client (hosted deployments also need internalUrl and partnerSecret).
2. Sunbird RC Insurance Registry: Create the record, then Search and confirm exactly one match. Duplicate records make eSignet answer auth_failed. The KBI challenge and the individualId are built from the insurance_registry_* collection variables, so there is nothing to keep in sync by hand.
3. VCI (Bearer): top to bottom.

Requires `pmlib_code` in the environment (or in globals).

request.description:
Only needed on a hosted deployment. A local eSignet leaves client-mgmt unauthenticated, so requests 2 and 3 work on their own and this one has nothing to talk to - internalUrl ships empty.

partnerSecret is deployment-specific and deliberately not committed: set it in your own environment.

authToken is written to the active environment (ENV Sunbird Insurance).

request.description: Search Insurance records by fullName, dob and policyNumber (the insurance_registry_* collection variables).
Deletes the record whose osid is in insurance_registry_osid (set by Create). When Search shows duplicates, set insurance_registry_osid to the one to remove.
